method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (JUST FALSE where the text says no, NOTHING with a NOTHING-kind tag where it does not answer); one regulative rule (the restraint as far as the Act leaves it valid, a SHANT) run by EVALTRACE inside an exported question that takes only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Restraints of Trade Act 1976 No 67 (NSW), corpus document nsw_legislation:2015-01-08/act-1976-067 from the Open Australian Legal Corpus (collected 10 March 2025; unofficial, possibly out of date), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/act-1976-067.txt (sha256 b52829a2109cf2766254e1560e6531c8c30977d83dd66d343320c5884c674620)

checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text.

scope: In: the whole operative Act, ss 2, 3, 4(1)-(5). Out: s 1 (name), s 2(3) and the note to s 3: machinery and notes. The content of public policy (the common law's reasonableness test), IR Act 1996 s 304, the Co-operatives National Law and Commonwealth competition law are outside the Act; reasons in NOTES.md.
